name: Groq
description: Ultra-fast LLM inference using LPU hardware. Supports Llama 3, Mixtral, and Gemma.

snippets.python:
from groq import Groq

client = Groq(api_key="YOUR_KEY")
res = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="llama3-8b-8192",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]
)
print(res.choices[0].message.content)

name: Hugging Face

    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],

)
print(res.choices[0].message.content)

name: Cohere
description: Enterprise RAG and embeddings. Best-in-class reranking and multilingual support.

snippets.python:
import cohere

co = cohere.Client("YOUR_KEY")
res = co.embed(
    texts=["Hello world"],
    model="embed-english-v3.0",
    input_type="search_document"
)
print(res.embeddings[0][:5])

vo = voyageai.Client(api_key="YOUR_KEY")

name: Stability AI
description: Stable Diffusion and SDXL image generation with high quality customizable outputs.

snippets.python:
import requests, base64

res = requests.post(
    "https://api.stability.ai/v1/generation/stable-diffusion-v1-6/text-to-image",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_KEY"},
    json={"text_prompts": [{"text": "a cat in space"}], "samples": 1}
)
with open("out.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(res.json()["artifacts"][0]["base64"]))
snippets.curl:
curl https://api.stability.ai/v1/generation/stable-diffusion-v1-6/text-to-image \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text_prompts":[{"text":"a cat in space"}],"samples":1}'

name: Google Gemini
description: Gemini 1.5 Pro and Flash models. 1M token context, vision, audio, and code support.

snippets.python:
import google.generativeai as genai

genai.configure(api_key="YOUR_KEY")
model = genai.GenerativeModel("gemini-1.5-flash")
res = model.generate_content("Hello")
print(res.text)
